race.comment: SCOTT GREYSCALE (7) is coming off a 6 length fourth but in a speedy 23.98 at Bendigo over 425m. Has the ability and expected to go close. PHOENIX TAN (1) could not have been more impressive last start in her solid 24.06 win at Bendigo in a Grade 5 over 425m. Harder here but expected to feature again. GERALDTON CREW (8) finished well back at Ballarat last time when a 11 length seventh (25.72) but scored four back at Horsham (27.45). Form here at the trip sound including three wins. Better than the latest run and deserves another chance. SPRINGER'S BOY (3) is among the chances again if he runs up to the latest effort.
